name: fal.ai
summary: Hosted image, video, audio and 3D generation models run through fal's queue API, plus model search, pricing and usage.

api_key.description: a fal API key (fal.ai/dashboard/keys), sent as 'Authorization: Key <key>'. Usage data needs a key with the BILLING preset.

notes: Submitting a job is model-specific (each model has its own input schema), so it is not a named endpoint here: send a raw POST to /{owner}/{app} (or /{owner}/{app}/{path} for ids with more than two segments, e.g. fal-ai/flux/dev) with the model's input as the JSON body. The answer gives request_id plus status_url, response_url and cancel_url.
Then poll fal.requests.status until COMPLETED and read fal.requests.result. Status and result take only the first two segments of the model id (owner and app).
Every submit spends money at the model's price (fal.models.pricing); results expire after an hour (6 minutes when 10 KB or larger).
The synchronous fal.run host, cancellation and fal Serverless deployment are not in this entry.

endpoints.name: Search models
endpoints.summary: Lists, finds or searches fal's hosted model endpoints by text, category or id, with metadata and optionally the input schema.

q.description: Free-text search over name, description and category.

category.description: Category filter, e.g. text-to-image, image-to-video, training.

expand.description: openapi-3.0 adds each endpoint's full input/output schema; enterprise_status adds enterprise readiness.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page; keep the other parameters unchanged.

notes: Works without a key, at lower rate limits. Use expand=openapi-3.0 to learn a model's input fields before submitting to it.

endpoints.name: Get model prices
endpoints.summary: Unit price and billing unit for given endpoint ids; most models bill per output (image, video), some per GPU time.

endpoints.name: Get usage and spend
endpoints.summary: Billed usage per endpoint over a date range: quantity, unit price, discounts and total cost, optionally as a time series.

timeframe.description: Bucket size; auto-picked from the range when unset.

timezone.description: Time zone for bucketing; default UTC.

notes: Needs a key with the BILLING preset (or the matching permission).

endpoints.name: Get a queued request's status
endpoints.summary: IN_QUEUE (with queue_position), IN_PROGRESS or COMPLETED for a request submitted to the queue.

owner.description: Model owner, the first segment of the model id.

app.description: Model app name, the second segment, without any further endpoint path.

request_id.description: Request id the submit call returned.

logs.description: 1 includes runner logs, where the model offers them.

notes: COMPLETED is also the state of a failed or cancelled request; fetch the result to tell them apart. NOT_FOUND means an unknown id.

endpoints.name: Get a queued request's result
endpoints.summary: The model's output (image/video/audio URLs and fields) for a completed request.

owner.description: Model owner, the first segment of the model id.

app.description: Model app name, the second segment, without any further endpoint path.

request_id.description: Request id the submit call returned.

notes: Kept 1 hour after completion, only 6 minutes when the result is 10 KB or larger. A model error comes back as that error.
